Class DataStore

java.lang.Object
storage.DataStore
public class DataStore extends Object
A singleton class that manages the main data collections for tasks, categories, priorities, and reminders.

Provides methods to load data from and save data to JSON files, and includes logic to ensure a default category and priority.

    • editCategory

      public void editCategory(Category oldCategory, String newName)
      Edits an existing category's name. Prevents renaming of "Default". Also updates tasks that reference this category.

      public void addReminder(Reminder reminder)
